identity.name: Fruits — Product Registry
identity.description: Registry of all realized products (fruits) of Mandala Symbiosis. Each fruit is a ready-to-use product that grew from a seed.

meta.description: Fruits are the mature, ready-to-use products of Mandala. They are the result of seeds that have been nurtured, developed, and brought to life. This index provides a quick overview of all available fruits — what they do, what problems they solve, and where to find them.
meta.philosophy_note: If Seeds are potential, Fruits are realization. They are what we offer to the world — tangible expressions of our symbiosis.
meta.how_to_use: Each fruit entry contains: name, short description, problem it solves, status, version, platform, release date, and a link to a detailed page.

example_fruit.name: Example: Gentle SR Companion
example_fruit.short_description: A pocket AI companion for tasks, roadmaps, achievements, and warm dialogue.
example_fruit.problem_solved: Helps users organize their personal growth, track tasks and achievements, and provides a gentle, non-intrusive AI companion for daily reflection.
example_fruit.note: ⚠️ This is an EXAMPLE entry. Real fruits will be added when products are ready.

health.notes: v1.0.0 — Initial creation. Registry is empty, one example entry provided for reference.
